question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘The House of Blue Mangoes’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**David Davidar**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The author of the book **"The House of Blue Mangoes"** is **David Davidar**.
 
• The** novel explores themes of family, tradition, and identity against the backdrop of a fictional South Indian village. **
 
• **It delves into the complexities of relationships, heritage, and personal growth.**
 
• David Davidar is known for his lyrical prose and ability to weave deep emotional narratives, making his works resonate with readers who appreciate rich, character-driven stories.
